title: I seem to have found a reliable method of inducing extremely vivid dreams.
content: This is not a recommendation and I hesitate to even mention it because it’s so addictive, but a low dose transdermal nicotine patch applied about two hours before bed works spectacularly well. Personally I don’t enjoy nicotine at all so I started out with the lowest dose I could find (7mg over 24 hours) and removed it immediately after waking up. If you’re going to try this be aware you CANNOT cut the patches to reduce the dosage! It removes the time release mechanism all together.
